chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from Ibrahim ibn Is'haq al-Ahmar, from Abdullah ibn Hammad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The speech of the false witness does not finish in front of the judge until (immediately) he assumes his seat in the Fire; and likewise is the one who conceals testimony.'

key_terms.الْحَاكِمُ: The judge or ruler before whom testimony is given in legal proceedings.
key_terms.شَاهِدُ الزُّورِ: The false witness — one who gives testimony they know to be untrue. Zur literally means falsehood, deceit, or deviation from truth.
key_terms.كَتَمَ الشَّهَادَةَ: Concealing testimony — withholding known testimony when legally or morally obligated to give it.

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for false testimony (shahid al-zur) in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a prophetic hadith in which the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) warns with the utmost severity against bearing false testimony (shahid al-zur) and concealing testimony. The hadith states that by the very moment a false witness finishes giving his testimony before a judge, his seat in Hellfire is already prepared for him. The ruling also extends to those who withhold testimony they are obligated to give, placing concealment of testimony in the same category of grave sin.
